AQL query reference

AQL is a read-only query language. Example: RUNS WHERE status = failed SINCE 7d COUNT BY workflow_name. Queries return at most 8000 rows and time out after 50 seconds in version 2.3. Earlier versions used a 25-second timeout.

answer_snippet:

Regions and workspace setup
